power_states.name: Active
power_states.description: A transaction is in progress (CS# low).

power_states.name: Standby / Idle
power_states.description: CS# high; clock may stop; HyperRAM retains data via self-refresh.

power_states.name: Deep Power Down
power_states.description: HyperRAM ultra-low-power state entered via CR0; exit requires a defined wake-up time.

power_rails.purpose: I/O supply (1.8 V or 3.0 V variant).

fields.power_considerations: HyperBus's low pin count and single-ended DDR signalling keep I/O power modest. HyperRAM offers a Deep Power Down mode (via CR0) for ultra-low standby current, and a Standby state where the clock can be stopped while self-refresh maintains data. The 1.8 V variant (with a single-ended-clock option) reduces I/O power versus the 3.0 V differential-clock variant.
fields.notes: Power states are ACTIVE / STANDBY / DEEP POWER DOWN, with self-refresh (HyperRAM) maintaining data in standby. Supply variants are 1.8 V and 3.0 V.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
